name: Glimmerpod Nursery
introDiscord:
Clusters of glowing Glimmerpods cover the nursery roots like tiny
lantern eggs. Beetles carefully tend them, and several pods pulse with
the same soft light as a very familiar Moon Sprite.
introTwitch:
Clusters of glowing Glimmerpods cover the nursery roots like tiny
lantern eggs. Beetles carefully tend them, and several pods pulse with
the same soft light as a very familiar Moon Sprite.

glimmerpod-nursery-approach.prompt:
Three routes weave through clusters of glowing pods. Glimmerpod Beetles
inspect each one with the seriousness of very tiny nurses.

left.message:
A Beetle is polishing one glowing pod.

You step too close.

The Beetle immediately positions itself between you and the nursery.

Protective parent mode activated.

right.message:
An offering basket rests between two open Glimmerpods. Star Candies
inside glow softly in the reflected green light.

forward.message:
Restorative sap sits beneath Shizuki's note:

'Glimmer likes the pods.

Pods like Glimmer.

Beetles tolerate me.

Acceptable social hierarchy.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative sap untouched. The nursery's social order
remains stable.

glimmerpod-nursery-depths.prompt:
Living rootways descend through increasingly dense clusters of
Glimmerpods.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a Star Candy cache beside a pod that opens when
you approach.

Inside the pod:

nothing.

It just wanted attention.

right.message:
A Glimmerpod Beetle watches you inspect one of the glowing pods.

You wave.

It raises its mandibles.

Your diplomatic credentials differ.

forward.message:
One Berry rests inside Shizuki's tiny illustrated field guide:

'GLIMMERPOD:
glows.

GLIMMER:
glows.

GLIMMERPOD:
plant.

GLIMMER:
claims distinction obvious.'

glimmerpod-nursery-threshold.prompt:
Moonlit fronds surround Emerald Nursery, where three final paths pass
through enormous mature pods.

left.message:
A tranquil grove pool rests beneath a huge Glimmerpod.

Shizuki wrote:

'Glimmer slept inside one.

Could not retrieve Glimmer for forty minutes.

Pod vacation.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative pool and respect all future Moon Sprite
vacation rights.

right.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer contains Star Candies and several empty
pod husks arranged like tiny lanterns.

forward.message:
A Beetle guards one enormous unopened pod.

It sees you.

It plants all six legs.

Absolutely not, apparently.

boss-antechamber.name: Emerald Nursery
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every Glimmerpod in the Nursery lights at once.

bossPromptDiscord:
Green light rolls across Emerald Nursery in waves.

Every Beetle immediately gathers around one enormous central pod.

The pod opens.

Something radiant moves inside while the entire nursery brightens around
it.

Use /yes to enter Emerald Nursery or /no to leave the glowing family
gathering undisturbed.
bossPromptTwitch:
Green light rolls across Emerald Nursery in waves.

Every Beetle immediately gathers around one enormous central pod.

The pod opens.

Something radiant moves inside while the entire nursery brightens around
it.

Use !yes to enter Emerald Nursery or !no to leave the glowing family
gathering undisturbed.
bossRetreatText:
You step away. The Beetles close ranks around the central pod as its
light slowly dims.

boss.revealText:
The enormous pod unfolds as a brilliant armored Beetle rises from its
center.

Radiant Podqueen reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Radiant Podqueen returns to the heart of the Nursery.

The smaller Beetles resume tending their pods.

One pod flashes twice.

Somewhere, Glimmer would absolutely flash back."
